questions.q: The RQ (Respiratory Quotient) for pure fat oxidation is approximately:
questions.explain: RQ is the ratio of CO2 produced to O2 consumed. Fat = 0.7, Protein = 0.8, Carbohydrate = 1.0. An RQ > 1.0 indicates lipogenesis (overfeeding).
